descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de inginerie
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group, a leader in IT and Engineering Consulting. We develop innovative and sustainable technical solutions that meet the needs of our local and international partners.
 About the role: 
 We are looking for a SAP ABAP Developer to contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the company's SAP system.For us, the role of a SAP ABAP Developer means much more than writing code based on tickets. We are looking for a colleague who will be part of the team that enhances the company’s SAP environment by understanding the business processes behind the developments and building robust, sustainable solutions. We are seeking a developer who is focused on the business impact of the functionalities delivered and who wants to see the results of their work reflected in the company’s day-to-day operations.The role focuses on the development, optimization, and maintenance of ABAP objects within the company’s SAP system, as well as close collaboration with functional teams.
 To ensure success in this role, you need the following experience and skills: 
Completed university degree
Relevant experience as a SAP ABAP Developer
Strong ABAP programming skills, including Reports, ALV, Module Pool, BAPI, BAdI, and Enhancements
Experience with Data Dictionary, debugging, and performance optimization
Knowledge of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO ABAP)
Experience with interfaces and integrations such as IDoc/ALE, RFC, Proxy, or EDI
Understanding of how ABAP developments integrate with functional modules such as MM, FI, CO, and SD
Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills when working with SAP functional consultants
Experience with S/4HANA, CDS Views, AMDP, Fiori/OData, or RAP is considered an advantage
 A typical day might include the following: 
Develop, test, and maintain ABAP objects based on functional specifications
Build reports, interfaces, enhancements, forms, and custom developments
Prepare technical specifications and development documentation
Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
Manage incidents, change requests, and user support requests
Collaborate closely with functional consultants, key users, and local and international IT teams
Carry out integration testing, regression testing, and go-live support activities
Continuously improve and adapt the SAP system to meet evolving business needs
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted within a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information provided is treated as confidential.
